thread:
Devon: heads-up — after the 4f3a2b merge I'm seeing decode p95 jump ~1.4x on small-batch workloads. Canary in prod flagged it. :grimacing:
CI-bot: perf-tests/job/decodes/457 failed: p95 132ms -> 190ms (baseline 140ms). Link: https://ci.example/runs/457
Lina: saw it too on nightly; logs point at prefetch+kv handoff timing. Stack traces show more memcpy in attn kernel path.
Alex: can we repro locally with the repro harness? I have a cluster with the exact model + shortseq fixture.
Devon: repro is easy: run `bazel run //perf:repro --model=gpt-small --seq=32 --batch=4` — you'll hit p95 ~185ms for decode.
Maria: bisect candidate — suspect commit 4f3a2b (prefetch reorder) or 9c7b11 (fused-op planner tweak). both landed in that window.
Jon: ran perf with `perf record -g` and flame shows heavy time in `attn_kernel::memcopy_prefetch()` and `kv_prefetch_scheduler::flush_slow_path()`. Attaching snippet:
```
  samples  stack  symbol
  42      ...    attn_kernel::memcopy_prefetch
  38      ...    kv_prefetch_scheduler::flush_slow_path
  12      ...    fused_op_planner::emit_move
```
Kevin: interesting — the scheduler now waits for a microbatch boundary before handing off KV pages, which could add latency for small batches. That change was in 4f3a2b.
Lina: can we test reverting just the reorder? quick revert branch `revert/4f3a2b-prefetch-order` CI queued.
CI-bot: revert PR created: https://git.example/p/r/789 — CI triggered.
Alex: while revert CI runs, let's add a targeted unit test that simulates shortseq/microbatch timing and asserts handoff latency < 5ms.
Devon: agreed. Also add a perf regression guard in CI to fail if decode p95 increases >10% on shortseq fixture.
Maria: if revert fixes, we'll roll it to canary and monitor cost metrics — batching heuristics could still be suboptimal after revert; follow-up work required.
Kevin: noting that fused-op planner tweak may still cause extra copies; I'll run the planner-only revert and compare numbers.
Jon: attaching perf artifacts: https://ci.example/artifacts/457/trace.svg
Devon: thanks. Action items: (1) wait for revert CI, (2) run planner-only revert if necessary, (3) add shortseq perf test + guard. I'll coordinate rollouts.
Lina: :thumbsup:
CI-bot: CI status: revert/4f3a2b-prefetch-order — queued -> running -> 12/12 passed.
Devon: revert cleaned up p95 to 138ms on repro. Canary hold lifted, rolling out new canary.
Alex: nice. Follow-up ticket for batching heuristics: INF-912.
